LanguageData.PS_SpecDesc_kindling: Opens the way. +3% to every psycast's primary stat.
LanguageData.PS_SpecDesc_onslaught: Offensive casts +20% power; synergies from offensive skills count double.
LanguageData.PS_SpecDesc_bulwark: Boons and shields +20% strength and duration.
LanguageData.PS_SpecDesc_flow: Halves the level-based heat and psyfocus cost penalty.
LanguageData.PS_SpecDesc_fervor: Offensive power rises with your current neural heat (up to +25% at maximum).
LanguageData.PS_SpecDesc_abandon: Reckless: +40% offensive power, but +40% psyfocus and heat cost.
LanguageData.PS_SpecDesc_echo: 20% chance a cast immediately refreshes its cooldown.
LanguageData.PS_SpecDesc_confluence: Synergy bonuses you receive are doubled.
LanguageData.PS_SpecDesc_tempest: When a psycast kills, refund half of that cast's heat and psyfocus.
LanguageData.PS_SpecDesc_maelstrom: Area casts surge outward: +50% radius and +25% duration.
LanguageData.PS_SpecDesc_sanctuary: Bastion of will: boons +50% strength and duration.
LanguageData.PS_SpecDesc_conduit: Synergy bonuses you receive are increased by 50%.
LanguageData.PS_SpecDesc_convergence: Convergence. +15% to ALL stats and synergies, and +5 to the per-skill level cap. Opens the seven Apotheosis constellations drifting above.
LanguageData.PS_SpecDesc_mastery: Choose one learned psycast - it gains +100% to its primary stat and ignores cost scaling.\n\nExclusive: only one of Overflow / Mastery / Discipline / Attunement.
LanguageData.PS_SpecDesc_discipline: Choose a path - its skills gain +50% per-level scaling and start one effective level higher.\n\nExclusive: only one of Overflow / Mastery / Discipline / Attunement.
LanguageData.PS_SpecDesc_attunement: Choose an element - casts of that damage type gain +25% power and radius.\n\nExclusive: only one of Overflow / Mastery / Discipline / Attunement.
LanguageData.PS_SpecDesc_overflow: +8% to ALL of a skill's stats (not just its primary).\n\nExclusive: only one of Overflow / Mastery / Discipline / Attunement.
LanguageData.PS_SpecDesc_siphon: Psycast kills restore 25% of that cast's psyfocus.
LanguageData.PS_SpecDesc_tm_gate: Begin the Halcyon path.\n\nNeural heat builds 20% slower and recovers 25% faster.
LanguageData.PS_SpecDesc_tm_mid: Neural heat builds 35% slower and recovers 50% faster.
LanguageData.PS_SpecDesc_tm_cap:
Perfect serenity.

• Neural heat builds 55% slower, recovers 90% faster.
• Immune to ALL mental breaks.
LanguageData.PS_SpecDesc_ar_gate: Begin the Singularity path.\n\n\u22125% psyfocus cost, +10% psychic sensitivity.
LanguageData.PS_SpecDesc_ar_r: \u221215% psyfocus cost, +25% psychic sensitivity, slow passive psyfocus regen.
LanguageData.PS_SpecDesc_ar_cap:
Verge on the archotech.

• −20% psyfocus cost.
• +35% psychic sensitivity.
• Steady passive psyfocus regeneration.
LanguageData.PS_SpecDesc_um_gate: Begin the Penumbra path.\n\nPsychic shadow steels the mind. +8% psychic sensitivity.
LanguageData.PS_SpecDesc_um_cap:
Sovereign of shadow.

• +34% psychic sensitivity.
• Immune to mental breaks, berserk and mind control.
• Aura: hostile psycasters within 9 tiles lose 50% psychic sensitivity.
LanguageData.PS_SpecDesc_em_gate: Begin the Empyrean path.\n\nThe mind reaches into the void between the stars. +10% psychic sensitivity; immune to the psychic drone.
LanguageData.PS_SpecDesc_em_a: The mind's eye opens onto far horizons. +18% psychic sensitivity.
LanguageData.PS_SpecDesc_em_b: Scattered thoughts align like distant stars. +24% psychic sensitivity.
LanguageData.PS_SpecDesc_em_c: Lit from within by far-off suns. +30% psychic sensitivity.
LanguageData.PS_SpecDesc_em_cap:
The mind joins the stars.

• +30% psychic sensitivity.
• Starlight aura: every nearby ally is bathed in borrowed starlight, their psychic sense sharpened.
LanguageData.PS_SpecDesc_cr_gate: Begin the Chronos path.\n\n+10% meditation focus; a slow passive psyfocus regen.
LanguageData.PS_SpecDesc_cr_cap:
Master of moments.

• +30% meditation focus.
• Strong steady passive psyfocus regeneration.
LanguageData.PS_SpecDesc_pn_gate: Begin the Pandemonium path.\n\nThe mind runs wild. +8% psychic sensitivity.
LanguageData.PS_SpecDesc_pn_cap:
Unbound chaos.

• +26% psychic sensitivity.
• Immune to mind control - no will commands the storm.
LanguageData.PS_SpecDesc_cn_gate: Begin the Consonance path.\n\nYour mind hums in sympathy with every psyche around it. +8% psychic sensitivity.
LanguageData.PS_SpecDesc_cn_a: Your mind tunes itself to those nearby. +14% psychic sensitivity.
LanguageData.PS_SpecDesc_cn_b: Many minds, struck as one note. +20% psychic sensitivity.
LanguageData.PS_SpecDesc_cn_d: Wills settle into agreement. +14% psychic sensitivity.
LanguageData.PS_SpecDesc_cn_cap:
One voice in many.

• +24% psychic sensitivity.
• Resonant chord: nearby allied psycasters fall into harmony with you, their psychic sense amplified.
